# Bundled scrcpy server

`scrcpy-server-v5.0` is the unmodified Android server from the official
[scrcpy 5.0 release](https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy/releases/tag/v5.0).
It is licensed under Apache-2.0; see [SCRCPY-LICENSE](SCRCPY-LICENSE).

- Asset: https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy/releases/download/v5.0/scrcpy-server-v5.0
- SHA-256: `26cbc9ad0aced6c2282455bef4fb43462605c1f8758c74b4ab1dbf818c229daa`

The plugin uses the Android server with its own client and browser video decoder.
